name: IRCCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: First held by Triple H, won in a battle royal at the fed's own inaugural PPV, Fight For The Titles '96; held by Stone Cold Steve Austin by IRCCWMania II, 20 May 1997, who retained it against Hollywood Hulk Hogan there.

name: IRCCW North American Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Scott Hall until IRCCWMania II, 20 May 1997, where Chris Benoit won it from him in a steel-cage War Match.

name: IRCCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Retained by Hakushi in a three-ladder match at IRCCWMania II, 20 May 1997 -- his second reign by his own broadcast team's count.

name: IRCCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Harlem Heat (Stevie Ray & Booker T) at IRCCWMania II, 20 May 1997, retaining there against The Gangstas.

name: IRCCW Continental Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Created at IRCCWMania II, 20 May 1997, and won there in its first-ever match by Kronus & Saturn (the Eliminators) over Deadly Force (Big Bubba Rogers & Bam Bam Bigelow) in a Philadelphia street fight.
